dialogue.content: こんにちわ相談員のヒロと申します。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, my name is Hiro, and I'll be your counselor today. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.content: こんにちわ　どうぞ宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, it's a pleasure to speak with you too.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, likewise. What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 友人の事で相談をお願いします
dialogue.English: I'd like some advice about a friend.

dialogue.content: はい、どのような事か教えてください。
dialogue.English: Of course. Please tell me about it.

dialogue.content: 結構長く付き合っている友人ですが　最近その子の性格に疑問を持ち始めました
dialogue.English: She's a friend I've known for quite a long time, but recently I've started to question her character.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、、長く一緒に居られたご友人のですね。どのような疑問なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so this is about a long-time friend. What kind of doubts are you having?

dialogue.content: 自分に対してだけではないですが　人を欺くといったらいいのか
dialogue.English: It's not just towards me, but... I'm not sure if 'deceiving people' is the right way to put it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 言葉がわからないのですが、　人を陥れるような
dialogue.English: I can't quite find the word, but it's like she sets people up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 友人を信用していない感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like I can't trust her as a friend.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、親友なのに寂しい感じになりますよね・・・何か、欺く、陥れられるような出来事とかあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. It must feel lonely when it's a close friend. Has something happened that made you feel deceived or set up?

dialogue.content: 今までは気づかなかったのですが別の友人が彼女に裏切られてとかいってました
dialogue.English: I hadn't noticed it before, but another friend mentioned being betrayed by her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、ご友人もですか・・・信頼し合ってる分、裏切られたかかなり辛くなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see, your other friend as well... It must be very painful to be betrayed when you trust each other, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 最近それが段々と信憑性が出てきて
dialogue.English: And recently, that story has started to seem more and more credible.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 確かに　最後には何か問題が起こってしまうな　と感じています
dialogue.English: I'm starting to feel that, yes, in the end, some kind of problem always seems to happen.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そう感じられる何かがあるわけですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see... So there's something that makes you feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しくお話お聴きしたいのですが、
dialogue.English: I'd like to hear a little more about that, but first,

dialogue.content: 相談者さま、なんてお呼びしたらよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: what would you like me to call you?

dialogue.content: ひとみといいます
dialogue.English: My name is Hitomi.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ひとみさん、差し支えなければ、年代と性別などお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Hitomi, if you don't mind, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 年は２４才　女子です
dialogue.English: I'm a 24-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: はい、有難うございます。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは続きを教えて頂きたいのですが、
dialogue.English: Now then, I'd like to hear the rest of your story.

dialogue.content: これまで、疑問に思われたこと、何だったのか、など記憶にある部分など教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me anything you can recall about what made you start having these doubts?

dialogue.content: 私は高校に入って最初にできた友達だったので　楽しくお付き合いしていましたが別の友人は　恋人を紹介したらその恋人を取られたとか　自分の事を他にしゃっべったって言ってました
dialogue.English: She was the first friend I made when I started high school, so we had a lot of fun together. But another friend said that when she introduced her boyfriend to her, she stole him away, and also that she spread her personal secrets to other people.

dialogue.content: 私は信じていたので　そんな事はあるはずないと
dialogue.English: I believed in her, so I thought there was no way that could be true.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、別のご友人もお辛い思いされてるのですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see... So your other friend went through a painful experience as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも別の友人は結局高校を中退する事になる始末、　原因はその恋人の事ではないですが、その子を恨んでいました
dialogue.English: But that other friend ended up dropping out of high school. The cause wasn't the boyfriend issue, but she held a grudge against her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そうですよね。このような事あったら恨みたくもなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... Yes, after something like that, it's natural to feel resentful.

dialogue.content: 私はクラスが離れて　卒業するまで　よい友達としていました
dialogue.English: We were in different classes, but we remained good friends until graduation.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、ひとみさんは親友として楽しくお付き合いされてたんですね。良かったです。
dialogue.English: I see—so you enjoyed your friendship with her as a close friend. I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: その後もいろいろ社会に出てからも電話で話したり近況を言い合ったりして過ごしていたのですが
dialogue.English: Even after that, after we started working, we would talk on the phone and catch up on each other's lives.

dialogue.content: 最近は、ひとみさんに対して、直接なにか、という事もあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Has she done anything directly to you recently, Hitomi?

dialogue.content: すいません、
dialogue.English: I'm sorry,

dialogue.content: そうなのです
dialogue.English: Yes, there has.

dialogue.content: 続けてください。
dialogue.English: Please continue.

dialogue.content: 私に直接というわけではないのですが、私の友人に相談をと言われて
dialogue.English: It wasn't directly to me, but she asked if she could talk to a friend of mine for advice.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 以前から紹介していた友人なのですが
dialogue.English: It's a friend I had introduced her to before.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 相談を持ちかけました
dialogue.English: She approached my friend for advice.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 悩みの分野で詳しいので
dialogue.English: Because my friend is knowledgeable in the area she was having trouble with.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しかし　その問題を解決するには内部事情を調べたりするので　とても大変な事だと思っていたのですが
dialogue.English: However, I thought it would be a very difficult thing to solve because it would require investigating internal matters.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: それを簡単に言われたりして、　あとの事はほったらかしにされたり
dialogue.English: But she spoke about it so casually, and then just left things hanging.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それはちょっと疑いたくもありますよね・・・
dialogue.English: That would certainly make you feel a bit suspicious.

dialogue.content: 自分の事の問題を打ち明けてくれるのは友人としては嬉しいですけど
dialogue.English: As a friend, I'm happy that she confides in me about her problems, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 周りを巻き込むのは　それなりに覚悟がいります
dialogue.English: Getting other people involved requires a certain level of commitment.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そのような状態なのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. So that's the situation.

dialogue.content: ひとみさんは、どうなれば良いかなとお思いですか？
dialogue.English: Hitomi, what outcome would you like to see?

dialogue.content: そう思っていたら　昔の事を思い出してきて
dialogue.English: As I was thinking that, I started to remember things from the past.

dialogue.content: はい、すいません。続けてください。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm sorry. Please continue.

dialogue.content: 昔のこと・・・どうような事があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Things from the past... What sort of things happened?

dialogue.content: その友人はどういう人なのか　はっきりさせたいと思いました
dialogue.English: I felt that I wanted to find out for sure what kind of person this friend really is.

dialogue.content: 例の中退した友人の事です
dialogue.English: It's about the friend who dropped out.

dialogue.content: 中退されたご友人のことですね、なるほど。
dialogue.English: You're referring to the friend who dropped out—I see.

dialogue.content: ひとみさんは、ご友人が一杯いらっしゃるようで、、
dialogue.English: It sounds like you have a lot of friends, Hitomi...

dialogue.content: いえ　今はそんなにいないです
dialogue.English: No, I don't have that many now.

dialogue.content: 信頼できる素敵な方と感じました。
dialogue.English: I feel like you're a wonderful person who can be trusted.

dialogue.content: 中退した子とは連絡をとっていないし
dialogue.English: I haven't been in contact with the one who dropped out.

dialogue.content: ご友人の事で悩まれて、親友思いの方ですね。
dialogue.English: You're troubled about your friend—you really care about your close friends.

dialogue.content: 今の友人は数人くらいです
dialogue.English: I only have a few friends now.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 数人の信頼できる友人がいらっしゃって素敵と思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's wonderful that you have a few trustworthy friends.

dialogue.content: 今まで信じていた子はとんでも無いことをしているのかなと思っています
dialogue.English: I'm starting to wonder if the friend I've trusted all this time might be doing terrible things.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか・・・信じていた分、お辛いですね。それは事実なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that so... It must be painful, especially since you trusted her so much. Is it a fact?

dialogue.content: それが事実かは分からないです　当事者からは詳しくは聞いていなかったので
dialogue.English: I don't know if it's a fact. I haven't heard the details from the people involved.

dialogue.content: うやむやにされています
dialogue.English: It's been left vague.

dialogue.content: 本当だとすると　ショックです
dialogue.English: If it's true, I'd be shocked.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そうなのですね。うやむやとは・・・疑ってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is. Being left vague... it makes you suspicious, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: ひとみさん、非常に大切なことで多く悩まれてますが、体調などいかがでしょうか？夜、眠れてますか？
dialogue.English: Hitomi, you've been troubled by something very important—how are you feeling physically? Are you able to sleep at night?

dialogue.content: はい　体調はそこまで問題はないです　眠れています
dialogue.English: Yes, I don't have much of an issue physically; I'm sleeping well.

dialogue.content: 良かったです。。少し心配になりまさして
dialogue.English: That's good to hear. I was a little worried.

dialogue.content: ただ　今後の付き合いを考えないとと思っています
dialogue.English: However, I do think I need to reconsider our friendship going forward.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、大事なことですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's an important thing to consider.

dialogue.content: ひとみさんは、今どのような行動をされてたりしますか？
dialogue.English: Hitomi, what actions, if any, have you taken so far?

dialogue.content: 私ですか？　行動とは？
dialogue.English: Me? What do you mean by actions?

dialogue.content: はい、、ご友人同士でご相談されてるとか、事実を確認されてるとか・・・
dialogue.English: Yes, like talking it over with your other friends, or trying to confirm the facts...

dialogue.content: まだ　誰にも言っていません　しいて言えば　紹介した友人とは連絡をとっています
dialogue.English: I haven't told anyone yet. If anything, I'm in contact with the friend I introduced her to.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、まだご相談はされてない感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you haven't really talked to anyone about it yet.

dialogue.content: 彼女とは今は連絡をとっていないです
dialogue.English: I'm not in contact with her right now.

dialogue.content: 話す気になれないです
dialogue.English: I don't feel like talking to her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、連絡はとってないのですね、、話す気になれないお気持ちもわかります。
dialogue.English: I see, so you're not in contact. I can understand not feeling like talking to her.

dialogue.content: このまま話さないでいく感じですか？
dialogue.English: Do you plan to continue not speaking with her?

dialogue.content: そうですね　用事がないので連絡はしないでおこうかなと思います
dialogue.English: Yes. I don't have any particular reason to, so I think I'll just avoid contacting her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、連絡しないでも、あまり問題ない感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, not being in contact with her doesn't really cause any problems?

dialogue.content: 今までの友情は終わったかなと思いました
dialogue.English: I felt that our friendship up to now might be over.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、今はそのような感じなのですね。親友だったのに、寂しい感じもありますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you feel right now. Since she was your best friend, do you also feel a sense of sadness?

dialogue.content: そうですね　寂しいとは思います　その反面今まで気づかなかった事を思えば　もっと早くこうすべきだったのかなとも
dialogue.English: Yes, I do feel sad. On the other hand, when I think about the things I hadn't noticed until now, I wonder if I should have done this sooner.

dialogue.content: 私が　うんうんっと聞いていたのが　彼女にとっては良くなかったことかもしれないです
dialogue.English: My habit of just nodding along and listening might not have been good for her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そのような感覚なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: 親友の話は、うんうんと聞きますよね、それが良くなかった感じだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When a close friend talks, we tend to just nod and listen, right? Do you feel that might not have been good?

dialogue.content: はい　全てを肯定的に聞いてしまったので　彼女は気づかないのかなとも思いました
dialogue.English: Yes, because I listened to everything so positively, I thought maybe she wouldn't realize what she was doing.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そのような気づきがあったわけですね。
dialogue.English: I see—so you've had that kind of realization.

dialogue.content: ひとみさん、これまでも一杯考えて、悩まれて、ここにいらっしゃったことと思います。ここまでお話お聴きし、１点私からよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hitomi, I imagine you've thought and worried a lot about this before coming here. Having listened to your story so far, may I offer one perspective?

dialogue.content: はい　お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ひとみさんがこれまでは長い間お付き合いしてきたご友人の皆さん、それぞれ親友として信頼して一緒にいらっしゃったと思います。
dialogue.English: I think you've trusted and been with your friends as close friends for a long time, Hitomi.

dialogue.content: 簡単に、裏切るとか、自分本位で居るとか、あまり考えたくはないですよね。もしかしたら、お互いが勘違いだった、、などという事も多々あるかと思います。
dialogue.English: You don't want to simply think that they're betraying you or being selfish. It's quite possible that there have been misunderstandings on both sides.

dialogue.content: そこで、、
dialogue.English: With that in mind...

dialogue.content: 気になる部分を、直接本人に確認してみるのはいかがでしょうか？そのうえで、やはり事実なのであれば、距離を置くことになるかもしれませんが。
dialogue.English: How about trying to talk to her directly about the things that are bothering you? After that, if it turns out to be true, you might decide to distance yourself.

dialogue.content: と感じました。ひとみさんはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's my thought. How does that feel to you, Hitomi?

dialogue.content: そうですね　確かに私も気づくのが遅かったので　突然と態度が変わってしまうようになってしまいますが、本当の友人としてだったら悪いことは悪いと言えなければダメですよね
dialogue.English: You're right. It's true that I was slow to notice, so my attitude might seem to change suddenly, but if we're true friends, I have to be able to tell her when she's doing something wrong, don't I?

dialogue.content: ええ、話してみるのも一つかと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, talking it over is one option.

dialogue.content: 異性関係は彼女の方がたけてるので　私が意見を言える立場ではないですが、あまりにも軽いのではないかとか
dialogue.English: She's more experienced than I am with relationships, so I'm not really in a position to give opinions, but I feel she may be too casual about it.

dialogue.content: 人を陥れるのは問題あると思います
dialogue.English: And I think setting people up is a problem.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのように見えちゃってるけど、大丈夫？とか、聞くのもありかと思います。
dialogue.English: You could perhaps ask her something like, 'This is how it looks to me, is everything okay?'

dialogue.content: また　行き詰まったら相談にきますので　宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: If I hit a wall again, I'll come back for another consultation—thank you in advance.

dialogue.content: 友人として忠告、なんて言い方もありますかね。
dialogue.English: You could also frame it as 'advising her as a friend.'

dialogue.content: なるほど　よい表現ですね
dialogue.English: I see, that's a good way to put it.

dialogue.content: はい、有難うございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: はい、本日は一杯お話いただき有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for sharing so much today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ　今日の課題を考えていきます
dialogue.English: Thank you, too. I will think about what we discussed today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日は有難うございました。また、進展などありましたら、お話しにいらしゃってください。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. Please feel free to come back and talk if there are any new developments.

dialogue.content: お世話になりました
dialogue.English: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: 本日は有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.
